CutScene.Text: They say that true Genius is made of equal parts Wisdom and Inspiration, with just the right dose of madness added to the mix.
I have a tale to tell you of such Genius. Of the wonders that it created, and ultimately… how it almost destroyed the world.
This tale has its roots in a distant age. So distant that few save the most ancient Dragons can remember.
There was once an Elven Prince, named Mordaine. Like many a younger child of royalty, the desire to rule burned fiercely in his blood.
Ever jealous of his brothers, Mordaine incited a rebellion – a bloody civil war - but after many years of bloodshed, he and his followers were defeated and exiled from their homelands.
They became known as the Dark Elves. And while they plotted and schemed, Prince Mordaine delved into dark magicks, searching for a spell – one that would bring him victory.
Finally, Mordaine, found his spell. He would open up a portal to the Dark Realms and summon forth four mighty creatures to do his bidding.
But the spell went awry. The magical backlash slew Mordaine and shook the very world itself. The earth cracked, mountains fell, and cities were washed away.
It was a dark time – 3000 years past - known as The Sundering. And it would have eventually passed from memory altogether… but some cannot let history lie.
